page.layout: One printed page: running head at top centre; one text block of full lines below it; a woodcut ornament below the text. No margin notes.

main_text.p: fulmen Hispanicæ turmæ trepidarunt, acuenturque animi vestri, ad propugnandam fortiter, quæ tanti stetit, libertatem. Suscipite itaque Illustrisimi Potentissimique D D. Princeps Excellentissime, sub tutela ac Protectione vestra hoc Opusculum meum, quo fretum audentius, contemptis malevolorum calumniis, in lucem prodibit; meque clientem vestrum ad maiora, ad publicam vtilitatem, gloriamq; vestram adgredienda impppellerit. valete ac viuite.

page.notes: Woodcut ornament (cartouche with scrolls and a pendant flower) below the text, not transcribed. Some words in the text are doubtful where the scan is faint or blurred, including "Illustrisimi", "impppellerit" and "meque", which should be checked against the original. The printed text reads "Illustrissimi", "impelleris" and "me que" in the scan; the transcription above follows the letters as best they can be read and is not certain.
